captions.detailed: A portable evaporative cooler fan designed with a boxy rectangular housing in a light gray finish, mounted on four small black casters at the bottom. The top features a raised rectangular control panel housing a single dark, cylindrical flow-rate control knob. On the back of the unit, a rectangular water fill door in a darker gray contrasting color is equipped with a black handle and opens on a side vertical hinge. The internal fan blades and the top control knob are designed to rotate continuously, while the water fill door swings open.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a portable evaporative cooler fan on casters. The model must feature a light gray rectangular main housing, four black casters at the base, a top-mounted control box with a rotating control knob, and a rear water fill door with a handle that pivots on a revolute hinge.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by building a main housing from a box primitive, customized with an inset front grill, side panels, and top panels. Four casters are added at the bottom corners using cylinder and box primitives. A rear water fill door is created as a separate part, complete with a small handle, and is attached via a revolute joint. The top control panel is constructed as a box containing a small cylindrical knob attached via a continuous joint. The internal fan blade assembly is modeled with a central hub and multiple angled blades, mounted inside the housing with a continuous joint.
